title: Edible Inedibles
description: this project adds food items purely meant for jokes and comedic effect.
body:
this mod currently adds two things:
- crunchy rocks
gives slowness and bad luck but is cheap and chuggable food source.

- yellow snow
- will give weakness, regeneration, and resistance 2, but has a 50% chance to also give nausea 10

more will likely be added in the future.![crunchy rock texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4438526d16b306225c1f9c14515a0a9bcfbc9fda.png)![yellow snow texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da3b9499a5d6571d6124ca347b59760f807cf225.png)
